assignment: Enumerate every live Object(NonMatching, ...) registration, identify units whose fresh objdiff fuzzy_match_percent is 100.0, and reclaim only already-proven exact matches; match no new functions

method.registration_parser: Python AST over every live Object call whose first positional argument is the NonMatching name and whose second positional argument is a constant string; this includes multiline registrations and excludes comments
method.score_source: build/GEDE01/report.json freshly regenerated by objdiff-cli v3.6.1
method.join_key: configure.py object path to objdiff unit metadata.source_path after removing the src/ prefix
method.candidate_predicate: registered NonMatching unit with aggregate fuzzy_match_percent exactly 100.0
method.reclaim_gate: A candidate must additionally pass a fresh focused objdiff with exact section ownership and size plus 100% instruction and relocation agreement, followed by the canonical link and retail-DOL SHA-1 gates

outcome: No live NonMatching registration has aggregate fuzzy_match_percent 100.0 in the fresh report. No registration or source was changed, no bytes were reclaimed, and no new function was matched.

matched_byte_accounting.terminology: Matched measures are objdiff report byte measures. Complete measures and unit counts are included separately because they are not interchangeable with matched-byte accounting or configure.py registration counts. The 32 already-matched code bytes within NonMatching units belong to one function in a partially matching multi-function unit and cannot promote that unit under the assignment's unit-level 100.0 gate.
